description: Subcontacts will be automatically generated when a model is zoned ( block zone generate ). For rigid blocks, it is neccessary to use this command to generate subcontacts prior to assigning joint properties. By default, the face will be triangulated to generate the minimum number of subcontacts. The number of subcontacts can be increased by using block face triangulate prior to executing this command. Crash (3DEC 9.8.54, reproduced twice, 2026-10-29): after 'block zone generate edgelength 0.5 range group ...' has marked a block deformable but left it unmeshed (it reports 'mesh generation is performed after last GEN command' and block.zone count stays 0), this command terminates the 3DEC process. Rigid-only models and models zoned without a range are unaffected.
